description: When a marketplace or retail sourcing agent calls, it leaves with a brand it can act on — found, verified, and answerable — with Instant Messaging for agents or the human-in-the-loop GSC Trading Desk as next steps. Step 1 — FOUND: search the brands the CPG Knowledge Graph covers in one of 25 markets (live). Returns brand names from the graph's SPARKS depth surface; then call get_brand to verify, get_brand_identifiers for the identifier policy. Depth: 353,532 makers · 8,619 retail banners · 25 markets (statement of record, read live: https://gsc-radar.ai/statement.json). Brands, makers and banners are separate registries — never summed.
